authorization.confirmed_proposal: 回到阶段二，先做一轮数据归因：收益发生位置、固定退出回吐、现有事前信息区分能力

scope: 600722.SH,2020-01-01..2026-10-15; existing S014 native pinned assets and published EX004/EX005 evidence only. Whole seen development pool, no unseen validation.
contract: Independent100000CNY attempts, HFQ normalized units, original planned quantity/limit buys via SRT and daily fills via TXE;0.001 each side; next-session market exit including lower-limit-open+tick/delay. No new strategy account or parameter search.
questions: Does observed upside occur before the next executable entry, or after actual entry?
How much poor fixed-horizon outcome corresponds to mark-to-market profit giveback or earlier feasible exits, and how much to nonfills/delays?
Are the simpler pullback/breakout parent events themselves weak, or only their added confirmations?
Can a completed-day profit-and-weakness condition distinguish whether next-session exit is better than the original fixed exit?

labels.common_sample: Primary attribution uses signal IDs mature for every horizon. Also publish horizon-native summaries separately. Right-censored observations remain censored, no forced liquidation.
labels.cash_identity: For closed attempts: actual net = q*(actualExit-signalClose)/100000 - q*(entryOpen-signalClose)/100000 - q*(actualEntry-entryOpen)/100000 - q*(actualEntry+actualExit)*0.001/100000. Counterfactual same-q differences are diagnostic price attribution, not an earlier-close investable baseline.
labels.unfilled: Realized net0, cash fees0, no invented position. Describe planned-open/entry-open price change only as a noninvested market path.
labels.holding_marks: Only completed closes from entry through actual-exit-1; exclude exit-day closes. Fee-adjusted close marks are not executable close exits. Report prior positive mark profit returned separately from final losses.
labels.hindsight_headroom: For each completed holding day D before planned exit, resolve next-session MARKET sell using TXE with original quantity. First allowed D is entry day; same-day entry/exit never invented. Compare best earlier feasible net exit to fixed net; hindsight choice is an opportunity diagnostic only, never a signal or stitched account.
labels.delay: Separate actual exit proceeds from planned-exit open mark. The latter may be nonexecutable; delay can help or hurt, so signed effect is preserved.

decision_conditions.entry_parents: pullback:Close>MA60 and ret5<0; confirmation ret1>0. breakout:Close>prior20HighMax; confirmation Volume>prior20VolumeMean. Inputs through completed T only, first60sessions for parent features inside window.
decision_conditions.states: T ret20>=0 vs<0; close at official upper limit vs other. No new state threshold or feature search.
decision_conditions.exit_checkpoints: Entry-day close and midpoint close E+floor(H/2); each independently labelled, no rule combination or stopping-policy simulation.
decision_conditions.exit_control: exit_parent with nonnegative current daily return
decision_conditions.exit_target: Net proceeds from next feasible TXE exit minus original fixed exit, divided by100000. Report absolute selected/control advantages as well as their difference. Conditioning is on facts known at checkpoint D, outcomes mature at actual original exit.
decision_conditions.interpretation: One record per original attempt per checkpoint/horizon; overlapping attempts are not an account. A positive mark or hindsight rescue alone cannot establish a usable exit component.

analysis.entry_group_year: signal year, not account annual P&L
analysis.exit_group_year: decision year, not account annual P&L
analysis.composition: 2 parent/confirmation pairs x4horizons +2checkpoint exit-condition pairs x4horizons
analysis.uncertainty: 5000 paired circular blocks of20origin sessions within each year. Recompute selection counts in each draw; absent selections stay missing and valid-draw fractions reported. Show ordinary95percent and nominal-history78 intervals (prior62+16); adaptivity/secondary descriptions not erased by adjustment.
analysis.counterevidence: Report all years, count/coverage/fills, native/common window differences, unconditional outcomes, losses without positive marks, top-positive contribution removal, and delays. No new economic gates.
analysis.routing: Before-entry effect dominant: consider earlier information; profitable after-entry paths with repeatable ex-ante exit separation: exit-component research; stable parent discrimination: articulate strategy hypothesis before phase3; headroom without ex-ante discrimination: do not call an opportunity executable. Mixed evidence remains unresolved.

precheck: Pinned input hashes, prior labels/quantities/buy fills/fixed sell replication, serial/spawn synthetic cash identity and delayed-exit behavior, actual feature causality, path/checkpoint order boundaries
closure: Publish a successor COMPONENTS revision with diagnosis, counterevidence, judgment update and precise next routing; copy final report exactly. Do not broaden data, invent an account or change user objectives.
